title: Sections are invariant under flat quasi-compact maps with connected geometric fibres
statement: Let $f:T\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and quasi-compact [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]. For every sheaf of sets $F$ on the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], pullback induces a bijection $\Gamma(S,F)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(T,f^{-1}F)$.
